question: Tess of the d'Urbervilles’ was written by :
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Thomas Hardy__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tess of the d'Urbervilles was Written by **Thomas Hardy.**
 
• Tess of the d'Urbervilles was a Novel that was Published in the year **1891.**
 
• Thomas Hardy was an English Novelist and Poet.
